stem: The masses, in kilograms, of large and small bags of potatoes have the independent distributions $\text{N}(2.5, 0.05)$ and $\text{N}(0.8, 0.02)$ respectively.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Find the probability that the total mass of a randomly chosen large bag of potatoes and a randomly chosen small bag of potatoes is more than 3.55 kg.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Find the probability that the mass of a randomly chosen large bag of potatoes is less than 3 times the mass of a randomly chosen small bag of potatoes.
